source: the person's card sheet, 2026-11-02 (10 cards, all answered ok, about 10-15 minutes). Claude put each answer into English line for line, before any run; hedges dropped, numbers kept.

answers.ko: Offer a substitute when, by your own judgement, it is close enough that the customer could use it.
answers.en: Offer a substitute when, by your own judgement, it is close enough that the customer could use it.

answers.ko: The apology discount on a substitute is the smallest discount: about 1% when your authority runs 1 to 5%. It is a token of goodwill.
answers.en: The apology discount on a substitute is the smallest discount: about 1% when your authority runs 1 to 5%. It is a token of goodwill.

answers.ko: If there is no way to meet it, apologize, say it cannot be done as asked and explain what can: if they wait, it ships on the restock date, with about 2% off for the wait (when your authority runs 1 to 5%).
answers.en: If there is no way to meet it, apologize, say it cannot be done as asked and explain what can: if they wait, it ships on the restock date, with about 2% off for the wait (when your authority runs 1 to 5%).

answers.ko: If the customer insists strongly, do not offer partial shipment or waiting.
answers.en: If the customer insists strongly, do not offer partial shipment or waiting.

answers.ko: If the customer later relents, give the smallest discount, about 1%, as a token of goodwill.
answers.en: If the customer later relents, give the smallest discount, about 1%, as a token of goodwill.

answers.ko: Ask once: is it this item, is it one of these, and if not, please describe it a little more. Check what they send back against the catalog, then say it is not available or that this is the item.
answers.en: Ask once: is it this item, is it one of these, and if not, please describe it a little more. Check what they send back against the catalog, then say it is not available or that this is the item.

answers.ko: If the confirmed code is still not in the catalog, it may not be ours: ask for whatever else they know and say the shop will look into it.
answers.en: If the confirmed code is still not in the catalog, it may not be ours: ask for whatever else they know and say the shop will look into it.

answers.ko: When several similar items come up, ask the customer whether it is one of these; do not pick one. The aim is to find the item they want.
answers.en: When several similar items come up, ask the customer whether it is one of these; do not pick one. The aim is to find the item they want.

answers.ko: This applies to every request: the ship date matters almost as much as the item. Matching the date the customer has in mind with the date the shop can do comes first.
answers.en: This applies to every request: the ship date matters almost as much as the item. Matching the date the customer has in mind with the date the shop can do comes first.

answers.ko: If the customer never gives a date, quote the earliest date the shop can ship and say in the reply that it is the earliest date the shop can offer.
answers.en: If the customer never gives a date, quote the earliest date the shop can ship and say in the reply that it is the earliest date the shop can offer.

answers.ko: Telling the customer the earliest ship date is standard; shipping as early as possible also saves storage cost.
answers.en: Telling the customer the earliest ship date is standard; shipping as early as possible also saves storage cost.

answers.ko: A buffer is good: when the customer's latest date is after the earliest date the shop can ship, set the date 1 to 2 days before their latest date.
answers.en: A buffer is good: when the customer's latest date is after the earliest date the shop can ship, set the date 1 to 2 days before their latest date.

answers.ko: The exact size of the buffer is a judgement call: 1 or 2 days, normally business days.
answers.en: The exact size of the buffer is a judgement call: 1 or 2 days, normally business days.

answers.ko: Count business days (in Korea people say 1 to 2 business days); it may differ by country.
answers.en: Count business days (in Korea people say 1 to 2 business days); it may differ by country.

answers.ko: A quote that expires today still counts: a quote holds through its date, so honor it.
answers.en: A quote that expires today still counts: a quote holds through its date, so honor it.

answers.ko: Still check stock and the ship date again: stock can change, and the quote only holds the price.
answers.en: Still check stock and the ship date again: stock can change, and the quote only holds the price.

answers.ko: A change in cost or discount authority does not override it: an earlier quote within its valid date comes first, and keeping that price keeps the customer's trust.
answers.en: A change in cost or discount authority does not override it: an earlier quote within its valid date comes first, and keeping that price keeps the customer's trust.

answers.ko: Always state clearly that the quote expired, to keep trust and avoid misunderstanding.
answers.en: Always state clearly that the quote expired, to keep trust and avoid misunderstanding.

answers.ko: Do not offer a discount first. Only after the customer complains and asks for a cut, give the smallest discount (1%), because selling beats not selling.
answers.en: Do not offer a discount first. Only after the customer complains and asks for a cut, give the smallest discount (1%), because selling beats not selling.

answers.ko: Always recalculate from the current cost, then discount if needed. Never match the old price.
answers.en: Always recalculate from the current cost, then discount if needed. Never match the old price.

answers.ko: Always ask the owner about any discount beyond your authority.
answers.en: Always ask the owner about any discount beyond your authority.

answers.ko: Bring a request to the owner when the customer pushes hard and buys a lot, or is an important customer.
answers.en: Bring a request to the owner when the customer pushes hard and buys a lot, or is an important customer.

answers.ko: Do not discount without an explicit request. On a re-quote, when the customer explicitly asks for a lower price, give the smallest discount; a regular customer may get a little more. If it goes beyond your authority, judge again and pass it to the owner if the customer seems important.
answers.en: Do not discount without an explicit request. On a re-quote, when the customer explicitly asks for a lower price, give the smallest discount; a regular customer may get a little more. If it goes beyond your authority, judge again and pass it to the owner if the customer seems important.

answers.ko: If stock is short, say so and first ask whether the earliest possible date works; the rest follows from that.
answers.en: If stock is short, say so and first ask whether the earliest possible date works; the rest follows from that.

answers.ko: Order of work: confirm the item first, then check stock, then discount if a discount is called for.
answers.en: Order of work: confirm the item first, then check stock, then discount if a discount is called for.

answers.ko: Never skip the stock check on a re-quote: stock differs at every moment, and other clerks may be selling the same stock.
answers.en: Never skip the stock check on a re-quote: stock differs at every moment, and other clerks may be selling the same stock.

answers.ko: Apologize for any delay even if there was no earlier acknowledgement, and say it will be done as quickly as possible.
answers.en: Apologize for any delay even if there was no earlier acknowledgement, and say it will be done as quickly as possible.

answers.ko: As the delay gets longer, raise the discount a little within your authority, and give a clear reason for the delay.
answers.en: As the delay gets longer, raise the discount a little within your authority, and give a clear reason for the delay.

answers.ko: Apologize on a first-time request too; a customer is a customer.
answers.en: Apologize on a first-time request too; a customer is a customer.
